meta.observationRule: Generate at t <= 1800, then retain the same event dynamics through max(1800, all cohort spawnT + actual dwellSec).
meta.outcomeDefinition: killed: recorded successful BDA while alive; leaked: original EXIT reached alive; neither intermediate rejection nor end-of-window censoring is a leak.

meta.configConvention: summary.config/raw.config preserve input generation cutoff 1800; observation.endTimeSec/cohort.observationEndSec/raw.result.config.endTimeSec are output observation endpoints.
meta.artifactScope: Completed-run summary; per-event raw logs are not included.
meta.dataChange: No numeric result changes; reporting labels and explanations clarified.
